content: Great question! Verso is fantastic for writing documentation. lean4-markdown is different: it's for when your program needs to emit Markdown as output. Think of it as writing docs vs generating them programmatically. If you're documenting your project, Verso is the right tool. If your code needs to produce Markdown with a typed AST, that's where lean4-markdown fits in :blush: .
